comments.text: Blocking: R1 says the response is the literal "Hello, !", with no place for the name. As written, A1 ("Hello, Ada!") contradicts it, because R1 would pass only for the literal text. The name was probably lost in formatting. Write the requirement with an explicit placeholder, e.g. "Hello, <name>!", and fix the same text in Scope.

comments.text: The spec does not define "no name supplied". An empty string and a whitespace-only name are not covered, and neither is a very long name. Say whether those count as absent, so the behaviour can be tested.
